name: LightControl
author: LightControl Project
description: Grow-lamp LED panel and emitted-light control from the in-game phone. Color and brightness drive the lamp's own emitting LED panel and the light that lamp emits from the one resolved color, so both match. Emitted intensity is relative to the lamp's own native intensity, plant materials are never modified, and slot-scoped storage restores the original. Host/singleplayer placed grow lamps, on top of a game-independent light-control model.
manualTrigger: Open the phone app 'Light Control' from the home screen. The app is only usable while a save is loaded and at least one supported grow lamp is placed; Escape closes it.
limitations: Host/singleplayer only; a multiplayer client is read-only and writes nothing. Two coupled outputs are written, and only these two: the lamp's own emitting LED panel (_EmissionColor of the native ledlight_light_on/off clone) and the lamp's own native light sources (ToggleableLight.lightSources[i]._Light), where only color and intensity are ever written. Because a real light colors what it illuminates, a lit lamp now tints the plants it shines on - that is the requested behavior; no plant or world material, shader or shader keyword is ever accessed, cloned or mutated, and no transform, range, cone, cookie, shadows, culling mask, render mode or enabled flag is ever changed. Emitted intensity is relative to that source's own freshly sampled native intensity (never the panel's HDR magnitude), so it cannot compound and a native intensity of 0 stays 0; emitted color is absolute. Coupled mode fails closed: a lamp is registered only once a verified panel slot and at least one readable own native light source both resolve; a lamp that is off with no resolved source is retained as pending and retried at a bounded cadence (never switched on by the mod), and a lamp that is on without a readable source is reported as unsupported and left completely untouched instead of being driven panel-only. Only the verified LEDLight panel family is supported; FullSpectrum and halogen grow lamps are left completely untouched. No group/room/property selection, no disco effects, no configuration or language binding. Not deployed by default (S1NoDeploy=true). Not verified in-game; acceptance tests T01-T18 are unexecuted.
removal: Close the game, remove Mods/LightControl.dll. Optional metadata and symbols are in UserData/LightControl/. Keep lamps_slot-<n>.json to preserve settings, or delete those files only if you want to discard the saved lamp data.
